summary: Essex Property Trust and its operating partnership filed an 8-K reporting entry into a $275 million unsecured term loan agreement dated September 24, 2026 with Bank of America as administrative agent. The loan matures September 24, 2029, carries two one-year extension options, prices at SOFR plus 0.800% under a ratings-based grid, and permits expansion to $500 million with lender consent. Proceeds repay commercial paper and fund general corporate purposes. Customary leverage and coverage covenants apply. This is ordinary financing activity rather than a special situation; watch refinancing spreads and CP market access.
